About.title: About Me
About.intro: Currently studying Computer Science and Information Engineering at NCUE. As a GDG on Campus Lead, I bridge the gap between academic learning and industry technologies, with a strong focus on hardware-software integrated security solutions.
About.researchTitle: Research: Post-Quantum Cryptography & Hardware Root of Trust
About.researchDesc: Addressing the threat of quantum computing to current encryption systems, this research focuses on developing high-stability Physical Unclonable Functions (PUF) as a hardware root of trust for Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC). By leveraging FPGA built-in XADC for environmental sensing and active compensation, we mitigate instability caused by PVT variations, achieving a high-performance key generation system compliant with NIST FIPS 203 standards.
researchItems: Design of a High-Stability PUF-Based Post-Quantum Key Generation System Based on FPGA XADC Environmental Sensing Mechanism
